issues: Do not encode the printed evolve cost line as a keyword. Remove "evolve" from keywords and encode the evolve linkage only with evolvesTo and evolveCost.

The fanfare is encoded as searchDeckChoose over the top 2 cards, but the source says to look at the top 2 cards of your deck, reveal a Machina card from among them, add it to your hand, and put the rest on the bottom in any order. This should be encoded as a top-of-deck reveal/choose effect rather than a generic deck search. Implement an ability for 'look at top N cards, optionally reveal a matching card and add it to hand, remainder to bottom' and use that here.

The startOfEnd ability is missing the condition 'if your followers attacked at least 3 times this turn'. Replace the placeholder always/conditionAny condition with an attack-count-this-turn condition. Implement a condition type for follower attack count this turn, then gate the draw 3 effect with count 3.

The spell trigger is encoded with a top-level filter field, but card-play triggers should gate with a condition/filter supported by the wrapper/effect model. Encode 'Whenever you play a spell' as an onCardPlayed ability that correctly restricts the trigger to spells, then deal 2 damage to an enemy follower.

The Storm condition is encoded incorrectly as fieldTraitMin with trait "token", but the source says 'While there are at least 3 cards on your field, this has Storm.' This should count all cards on your field, not token-trait cards. Implement a condition type for total cards on your field (or total field cards) and use it to grant Storm while count is at least 3.

The fanfare condition is missing. Replace the placeholder always condition with 'If there's a token follower on your field' before giving this follower +1/+1. Implement a condition type for presence/count of token followers on your field, then use that condition to gate the self buff.

The additional cost is encoded as part of the spell effect sequence, but the source says it is an additional cost to play the card. Move the engage-a-7-cost-or-more Dragoncraft follower requirement out of the resolving effect and encode it as a play/additional cost restriction for the spell.

The additional cost target restriction is malformed: the target selector should not contain a nested filter object here. The selected ally follower must be restricted to Dragoncraft and cost 7 or more using supported target fields or a proper cost-target encoding.

The damage effect is incorrect. 'Deal 2 damage to each enemy leader' should damage only the enemy leader, not all enemy followers and leaders. Replace dealDamageAllEnemies with the correct leader-only damage effect.
